name: Fold legacy CLI verbs into the canonical command set
goal: Consolidate redundant verbs via deprecated-alias shims and a unified 'init' entrypoint, preserving first-contact/genesis/bootstrap/discover/governance subsystems and their tests. Canonical targets: status (was report/explain status), validate verify (was verify), docs agents (was project AGENTS.md), init --brownfield/--analyze/--greenfield (was bootstrap/discover/first-contact/genesis). Deprecate intent + migrate as load-bearing-for-alignment legacy verbs.
